And Bildad the Shuhite answered and said:
"Dominion and dread are with him; he makes peace in his heights.
Is there any number to his troops? And on whom does his light not rise [alt: And against whom does his ambush not rise up, as the old Greek version reads]?
"And how can a mortal be righteous with God, and how can one born of a woman be pure?
Look, even the moon does not shine, and the stars are not pure in his eyes;
how much less a mortal, who is a maggot, and a human being, who is a worm!"
